title: Blacklist fixes worth checking your server for
changes: Fixed: blacklisting someone by their Discord account did not stop them verifying straight back in. They were kicked once, and after that the verification check only looked at gamertags and IP addresses, so anyone who had never verified on your server before was not blocked at all. It checks the Discord account now. If you have blacklisted people in the past it is worth a look through your member list
Fixed: an IP ban added from the web dashboard never banned an address. It said it worked and did nothing
Blacklisting with an IP ban used to say the ban was applied even when there was no address on record for that account. It now tells you when it could not, and what is still blocking them
The website is up to date: the pricing page lists what Premium actually includes, says what the free plan limits are, and the free 7 day trial is on there now
